name: Sandhamn
description: Sandhamn is an easy 8.1 km clockwise SAT loop from Sandhamn ferry quay on Sandön. It moves from the harbor village into sandy pine forest and open-coast beach terrain, with Trouville and other beaches, village heritage, and several seasonal food and lodging services close to the start/end. Treat services as strongly seasonal, and keep camping, fires, marina utilities and AEDs behind verification guards.
utilities: Primary public hiker utilities are the harbor public toilet/water at about [59.2879099, 18.9170226] and the mapped beach toilets at Trouville and Fläskberget.
KSSS guest-harbor water, showers, waste, fuel and electricity are marina/boat-guest infrastructure unless a later pass verifies free public hiker access.
Westerbergs Livs is the main village resupply candidate but requires Tempo-app/self-service access outside staffed hours.
Village food/lodging services are clustered near the ferry quay and should be rendered with strong seasonal/current-hours caveats.
waterSources: Primary refill: public harbor toilet/water at [59.2879099, 18.9170226], about 100 m east of Sandhamn ferry quay; SAT and OSM support 08:00-20:00.
Do not treat KSSS dock water as public hiker water: KSSS frames it as guest-harbor/desalination water with limited production and max 50 liters per boat.
Do not plan a Fläskberget refill. Only OSM currently tags drinking_water=yes there; local sources confirm toilets/facilities, not drinking water.
notes: Route shape: clockwise round trip on Sandön from Sandhamn ferry quay.
Sandhamn is the village and Sandön is the island; use both names carefully in descriptions.
The loop passes harbor village, sandy pine forest, exposed sea views, Trouville, Västerudden, cemetery/chapel context and back through the village.
Village-wide pilot/customs history is important context but is better represented by the Tullhuset/museum POI plus description text than by a separate no-coordinate POI.
Do not apply Blekinge/Karlskrona Sandhamn Natura 2000 SE0410225, Sandhammaren reserve in Skåne/Ystad, Gotska Sandön/Fårö facts or Svartkobben rules to the main SAT Sandhamn loop.
